claims.text: Meaning 'The Nine Little Streets', this vibrant neighbourhood is made up of exactly nine narrow streets that link the city's main canals.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: While the area itself is much older, the vast majority of the beautiful buildings you see here today actually date back to the 18th century.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Incredibly, this relatively small shopping district preserves more than 140 officially recognised national and municipal historic monuments.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The clever idea to group these streets together and promote them as a unified shopping destination was originally hatched by local entrepreneurs in 1996.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Even though many locals initially thought it was a terrible name, 'The 9 Streets' quickly stuck and helped put the neighbourhood on the map.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Today, it is considered one of Amsterdam's most fashionable areas, packed tightly with charming vintage boutiques, specialist shops, and cozy cafes.
